Bryan McClendon
Bryan Edward McClendon (born December 28, 1983) is an American football coach and former player. He is currently the co-offensive coordinator and wide receivers coach at the University of South Carolina. McClendon formerly coached wide receivers at the University of Georgia and was interim head coach for the 2015 TaxSlayer Bowl due to Mark Richt's no longer coaching the team. He had coached the running backs since 2009 but took over the role of coaching the wide receivers when Thomas Brown was hired from Wisconsin Badgers. Brown also served as the Recruiting Coordinator for Georgia. On January 12, 2015, he was promoted and given the title of Assistant Head Coach.
